verdict.rationale: The Division of Corporations collects and holds filer and entity data, so a policy or opt-out on AI-model training is a fair privacy-posture question for this service. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any such policy, opt-out, or data-use control. The probe finding a missing robots.txt concerns crawler policy on the filing host, which is adjacent and not a user-facing training opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
